description: The aim of this course is to introduce students to nanochemistry research. Students will be able to undertake literature review, work on experiments together with techniques related to nanomaterial synthesis, characterization and applications. After completion of this course, the student will acquire some competence in analysing problems in nanoscience and propose viable solutions.
